name: Rain NO on dry forecasts
description: rain-no's rule (taker NO at the YES bid in the last 6 h before the local-midnight close, YES bid 10-90c) restricted to city-days where the day-ahead Open-Meteo forecast (previous_day1) has <=0.1 mm of rain left before the close. Retail keeps YES near 25-30% even when the forecast is dry.
hypothesis: On 42 development days, KXRAIN markets with no forecast rain left at the 6 h mark were priced ~25% and resolved YES 11.6% (n=198); with forecast rain the price was about right. So the rain-no edge lives in dry-forecast markets and wet-forecast entries only dilute or lose. Counterparty: retail anchoring on a 'chance of rain' floor. Wrong if the full CI <= 0, 2x latency loses, the lockbox (Sep 1+) loses, or it adds nothing over rain-no's unfiltered +14c.
